title: Program Manager | Security and Compliance
description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.

  

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.

**About the Role**

The Technical Program Manager will drive the execution of the CISO/DPO function, ensuring security, privacy, and compliance priorities are translated into clear programs, timelines, and measurable outcomes. This role will partner with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to align cyber security, GRC, and compliance initiatives with business goals while maintaining strong accountability across teams.

**What will you do at Fynd?**

* Own and coordinate the end-to-end execution of the CISO/DPO function, ensuring timely delivery of security and compliance programs.
* Partner with CxOs, leadership teams, and key stakeholders to align priorities, communicate progress, and resolve blockers.
* Prioritize security, compliance, and GRC initiatives based on business risk, regulatory needs, and strategic importance.
* Drive program governance, tracking, reporting, and follow-ups across middle management, EMs, and functional teams under CISO oversight.
* Coordinate cyber security and privacy-related projects to ensure adherence to internal policies, external regulations, and audit requirements.
* Develop and maintain schedules, milestones, dependencies, and status updates for multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Facilitate stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring clear communication and accountability.
* Support compliance readiness by working closely with teams to close gaps, track remediation, and improve control effectiveness.
* Well versed with AI tools and open to learn new technologies.

**Some specific Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 5-10 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Security Program Management, or related roles
* Strong understanding of cyber security, GRC, compliance, and privacy operations
* Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with senior leadership stakeholders
* Ability to prioritize security initiatives, manage timelines, and drive execution to completion
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage CxO-level leaders
* Experience supporting or managing CISO or DPO office functions
* Familiarity with privacy and security regulatory frameworks and audit readiness
* Experience working in a fast-paced technology organization
* Certification in PMP, CISM, CISSP, or related security/program management credentials
* Experience coordinating with middle management and engineering leaders to ensure delivery

**What do we offer?**

### **Growth**

At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we're seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us. We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers. Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we'll reimburse the costs to support your development.

### **Culture**

We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections. - Regular community engagement and team-building activities - Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

### **Wellness**

Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents.

### **Work Environment**

We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Senior ISMS Compliance Manager
description:
### **Description**

The Senior Information Security Governance Manager is responsible for maintaining Anthesis’ ISO 27001:2022 certifications across multiple business processes and ensuring the continued effectiveness of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).

The role provides governance, compliance, audit, and assurance support while contributing to customer trust, vendor assurance, and regulatory compliance initiatives. It coordinates certification activities, risk management, control monitoring, audit readiness, and compliance reporting, while supporting the future implementation of ISO/IEC 42001 and broader AI governance initiatives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **ISMS & Certification Management:** Maintain and continuously improve the ISO 27001:2022 ISMS; coordinate Wallbrook, Digital, and MERO certification scopes; manage surveillance and recertification audits; maintain the Statement of Applicability, policies, standards, procedures, and evidence; track findings, corrective actions, observations, and non-conformities; and ensure ongoing audit readiness.
* **Governance, Risk & Compliance:** Facilitate information security risk assessments and treatment activities; monitor control effectiveness and compliance obligations; support internal control reviews and assurance activities; maintain metrics, dashboards, and reports; and improve security policies and standards.
* **Client Assurance & Compliance Support:** Support customer reviews, due diligence, vendor assurance, security assessments, and questionnaires; maintain evidence repositories and certification documentation; assist contract compliance reviews; and support customer and procurement requirements.
* **Audit & Stakeholder Management:** Coordinate internal and external auditors; work with control owners to obtain evidence and implement corrective actions; guide business and technology stakeholders; support management reviews and executive reporting; and promote security awareness and governance maturity.
* **AI Governance Readiness:** Support governance frameworks aligned with ISO/IEC 42001, including AI risk management, policy development, compliance activities, governance initiatives, and future certification readiness.
* Other duties as assigned by the manager.

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**Competences and Skills**

* Strong understanding of ISO 27001:2022 requirements and certification processes.
* Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, GDPR, and related frameworks.
* Experience managing audits, evidence collection, and corrective action programmes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate across Security, Legal, IT, Sales, and business functions.
* Excellent documentation, organisation, and reporting capabilities.
* Strong analytical and risk-based decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently across multiple priorities and time zones.

**Training and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Risk Management, Audit, or a related discipline.
* 8-10 years of experience in information security governance, compliance, ISMS management, audit, or risk management.
* Demonstrable experience supporting or maintaining ISO 27001 certification programmes, audits, compliance assessments, evidence management, and regulatory requirements.
* Professional proficiency in English.

**Desirable**

* ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification; ISO/IEC 42001 or AI governance experience; customer, vendor, or third-party assurance experience; and certifications such as CISA, Security+, CRISC, or CISSP.

### **About Anthesis Group**

**Our commitment to building and maintaining a diverse workforce**  
  
Anthesis has clients across all industry sectors and supports some of the world’s largest multinationals such as Reckitt, Cisco, Tesco, The North Face, and Target. The company brings together 1,300+ experts operating across 22 countries and 44 office locations with offices in Australia, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, China, Colombia, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, the Middle East, Netherlands, the Philippines, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK, and the US.  
  
We encourage all employees to contribute their ideas, perspectives, and experiences to help us create an inclusive and equitable workplace. By embracing diversity and providing equal opportunities, we believe we can drive innovation, foster creativity, and achieve our shared goals. So, if you’re ready to be a part of something truly extraordinary, then we want you! Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.  
  
Together, we can continue to build a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive.  
  
If you require any reasonable adjustments to be made to your application process, or need this job advert in a different format, just let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

title: Lead - Governance, Risk & Compliance
description:
:

**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

**Lead – Governance, Risk & Compliance**

ZS is looking for a skilled and driven **Lead– Governance, Risk & Compliance** to join its Governance, Risk, and Compliance team. The consultant will serve as a hands-on Technology Risk Assessment subject-matter expert for applications, products, platforms, AI solutions, tools, cloud services, third-party technologies, and emerging technologies.

* Independently lead and deliver Application Security Governance, AI Risk Assessment, project-risk and material-change assessments for internal, client-facing, cloud-hosted, client-hosted, third-party and AI-enabled solutions.
* Determine assessment scope and applicable control requirements based on business criticality, data classification, external exposure, hosting model, technology stack, user population, regulatory and contractual obligations, AI usage, third-party dependencies and change magnitude.
* Develop a detailed understanding of product functionality, user journeys, architecture, data flows, trust boundaries, integrations, deployment models, administrative access and operational dependencies to identify credible risk scenarios.
* Assess solutions across ideation, architecture, design, development, testing, release, production operations, material change, migration and decommissioning.
* Participate in architecture reviews, design governance, stage gates, release-readiness reviews and production-readiness reviews, and provide documented risk recommendations.
* Evaluate inherent risk, control design and operating effectiveness, residual risk, compensating controls, remediation plans, exceptions and closure evidence using the approved risk methodology.
* Conduct review sessions with product owners, architects, engineers, developers, data scientists, security, privacy, legal, compliance, procurement and operations teams.
* Produce clear and defensible assessment reports documenting scope, assumptions, system context, evidence reviewed, risk scenarios, findings, ratings, residual risk, actions, dependencies and approval recommendations.
* Oversee high and critical remediation items, including accountable owners, target dates, interim safeguards, escalation, risk acceptance and closure validation.
* Support material incidents and risk escalations, identify root causes and recurring control weaknesses, and recommend program-level improvements.
* Develop management reporting covering assessment coverage, material findings, overdue actions, exceptions, recurring issues, trends and remediation performance.
* Contribute to policies, standards, procedures, control libraries, evidence standards, assessment playbooks, training, automation and continuous improvement.
* Secure SDLC and DevSecOps, including architecture review, threat modelling, SAST, DAST, API testing, software composition analysis, secrets management, penetration testing, CI/CD security, infrastructure as code and remediation validation.
* Modern architectures, including microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, mobile, data and analytics platforms and low-code/no-code solutions.
* Identity and access management, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, environment segregation, third-party integrations, incident response, availability, backup, recovery, resilience and secure decommissioning.
* Technical evidence, including architecture and data-flow diagrams, API specifications, threat models, cloud configurations, pipelines, test reports, vulnerability reports, deployment workflows, operating records and control demonstrations.
* Assess AI and machine-learning solutions across data sourcing, model selection, training or fine-tuning, validation, hosting, access, integrations, third-party dependencies, deployment, monitoring, human oversight, suspension and retirement.
* Evaluate generative AI, foundation and open-source models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, copilots, AI APIs, vector databases, plugins, tools and Model Context Protocol integrations.
* Assess risks including prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, sensitive-data disclosure, model or data poisoning, hallucination, bias, toxicity, privacy leakage, excessive agency, weak tool permissions, supply-chain exposure, model theft and unsafe actions.
* Review data provenance, lawful use, consent, quality, representativeness, lineage, retention, intellectual property, training and inference-data protection, residency and cross-border requirements.
* Evaluate accuracy, robustness, explainability, benchmark selection, performance thresholds, validation independence, human approval, action limits, memory, identity propagation, kill switches, rollback and fail-safe behaviour.
* Define or review monitoring for model and data drift, anomalous behaviour, harmful outputs, performance degradation, incidents, complaints and regulatory or use-case changes.
* ISO/IEC 27001 and 27005, ISO 31000, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53/30, NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SP 800-218), SOC 2, CIS Controls and Cloud Security Alliance guidance, including the Cloud Controls Matrix.
* OWASP Top 10, Application Security Verification Standard, API Security Top 10, Software Assurance Maturity Model, OWASP guidance for LLM applications.
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, AIUC‑1, responsible AI principles and applicable AI regulatory expectations, including the EU AI Act where relevant.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline.
* **Minimum of 6+ years** of professional experience in technology risk, Application security assessment, Cybersecurity assurance, security architecture, IT Audit, AI assessment & governance, DevSecOps governance — with significant experience at a Big 4, Big 3.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and executing technical security audits — hands-on experience conducting walkthroughs, reviewing evidence, and making independent control assessments
* Strong technical foundation across SDLC governance, CI/CD pipeline security, cloud security controls, access and identity management, application security, and secrets management
* Demonstrated experience independently scoping, conducting, documenting and concluding complex application or technology risk assessments.
* Experience reviewing the work of other assessors and challenging scope, evidence, control conclusions, findings, ratings, remediation and closure decisions.
* Ability to distinguish control design effectiveness from operating effectiveness and determine whether evidence is complete, current, relevant, reliable and sufficient.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, stakeholder-management, technical-writing and executive-communication skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and manage concurrent priorities.
* Mandatory certifications — CEH, ISO 27001 Lead auditor, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

:

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

title: Legal Consultant
description:
Job Description

Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.

  
  

**About Seclore:**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit **www.seclore.com**.

  
  

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

  
  

We are seeking a customer-focused Technical Consultant to provide end-to-end technical consulting, solution design, deployment, upgrades, migrations, troubleshooting, performance analysis, training, and documentation for Seclore solutions. The role requires hands-on expertise across Windows/Linux infrastructure, web and application servers, databases, networking, security, Docker, and cloud technologies — plus the ability to translate complex customer requirements into practical solutions and use AI tools responsibly to boost technical productivity.

  
  

**A sneak peek into the role:**

We’re looking for a lawyer whose primary focus and expertise is in **commercial technology contracts.** You’ll work on **drafting, redlining, and finalizing contracts** with clear guidance from senior counsel, with the expectation that you’ll operate independently over time.

  
  

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

* Core contracting: Draft and review technology/commercial agreements (NDAs, SaaS subscriptions, MSAs/SOWs, software licenses, partner/reseller, and vendor/procurement contracts); assist in negotiations and escalate nonstandard terms.

* Contract negotiation support: Prepare contract markups, issues lists, and concise negotiation summaries; join and, where appropriate, lead external customer/vendor contract calls with clear positions; capture decisions, action items, and next steps.

* Contract management tools: Manage contracts in a contract management system from request to signature: log requests, route approvals, track versions, capture key terms, track obligations, and maintain reports.

* Research & writing: Targeted research on legal and contract questions and crisp guidance notes for business teams.

* Business partnering: Provide practical, timely support to Sales, Procurement, Product, and Finance; coordinate with external counsel as needed.

* Other: Pitch in on special projects and general legal tasks as required.

  
  

**We can see the next Entrepreneur At Seclore if you have:**

* Education & experience: LL.B. (or equivalent). 2–4 years focused on commercial/technology contracts inhouse or at a techsavvy firm.

* Drafting & redlining: Strong grasp of endtoend drafting and review; translate business positions into precise contract language.

* Contract management systems: Handson with at least one contract management tool; comfortable managing workflows, metadata, and dashboards.

* AI & technology skills: Comfortable using AI tools for legal work (e.g., drafting summaries, clause suggestions) and verifying outputs; proficient with Track Changes, spreadsheets, and common productivity tools.

* Tech/IP basics: Comfortable with SaaS terms, IP ownership/licensing, confidentiality, warranties, indemnities, and liability caps. U.S. contract exposure is a plus, not a must.

* Communication & collaboration: Clear writing, stakeholder management, and timely escalation; experience handling external negotiation calls with customers and vendors.

* Work style: Extremely organized, curious, and reliable; delivers on timelines with appropriate guidance.

* Global support & hours: Supports Seclore’s global operations; willingness to work occasional US and Middle East hours when needed.

  
  

**Why do we call Seclorites Entrepreneurs not Employees?**

* We value and support those who take the initiative and calculate risks.
* We have an attitude of a problem solver and an aptitude that is tech agnostic. You get to work with the smartest minds in the business.
* We are thriving not living. At Seclore, it is not just about work but about creating outstanding employee experiences. Our supportive and open culture enables our team to thrive.
  

  

**Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together.**

title: Corporate & Commercial Legal Executive
description:
To support the organisation’s corporate and commercial legal activities, including contract drafting and review, legal documentation, corporate compliance, commercial risk assessment and coordination with internal stakeholders and external legal advisors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Draft, review and support negotiation of NDAs, MoUs, LOIs, term sheets, vendor, supply, distribution, licensing and manufacturing agreements, SLAs and other commercial contracts.
* Review payment terms, indemnities, warranties, liability, confidentiality, termination, dispute resolution and governing-law clauses; flag risks and deviations for senior legal review.
* Coordinate with Business Development, Sales, Procurement, Finance and other departments to finalise agreements and secure required approvals before execution.
* Maintain a central contract repository and track amendments, execution, expiry dates, renewals and key obligations.
* Support corporate records, statutory registers, resolutions, authorisations and governance documentation; coordinate with external Company Secretaries and legal advisors on filings and compliance requirements.
* Research applicable Indian corporate, commercial and contract laws and prepare legal notes, contract summaries and risk assessments.
* Assist with commercial disputes, contractual claims, legal notices and recovery matters; coordinate with external advocates and track case updates, hearing dates and pending actions.
* Support international agreements and documentation for cross-border transactions, licensing, technology transfer and CDMO/CMO arrangements, coordinating with external advisors on jurisdiction-specific requirements.
* Maintain legal trackers and periodic MIS reports covering contracts, renewals, notices, disputes, compliance obligations, pending approvals and potential risks.
* Maintain confidentiality, accurate document control and systematic follow-up.

Qualifications and Experience

* LL.B. from a recognised university.
* 1-3 years of experience in corporate and commercial legal matters, preferably in the pharmaceutical or manufacturing industry.
* Working knowledge of commercial contract drafting, contract review and Indian corporate and commercial laws.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Word and Excel.

**Key Skills:**

Commercial contract drafting and review; contract lifecycle management; contractual risk assessment; legal research; attention to detail; confidentiality; stakeholder coordination; negotiation support; documentation; reporting and follow-up.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Senior Tax & Compliance Analyst - VCS
description:
What You'll Do:

The Senior Analyst, VCS plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI-enabled execution of Avalara’s U.S. Voluntary Compliance Services (VCS) operations across multiple jurisdictions and complex client environments. As client complexity, historical exposure, and voluntary disclosure volumes increase, this role ensures consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality. This individual contributor is expected to operate as a Bar Raiser, elevating execution rigor, mentoring junior analysts, and applying AI in measurable ways to improve speed, insight, and operational scale across the VCS lifecycle (from transactional data intake and nexus validation through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting of historical returns prepared for filing).
  
**#Hybrid**

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* For Customers Delivers high-accuracy, on-time preparation of historical Sales & Use tax returns for filing — through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting — across multiple jurisdictions, along with voluntary disclosure submissions, proactively mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* Acts as a senior point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, providing clear status communication and documentation that help customers understand risk remediation and the outcome of their VCS engagements.
* For the Business Improves operational leverage by: Reducing manual effort in transactional data validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, and notice handling.
* Standardizing VCS status, nexus, and exposure reporting. Accelerating turnaround for large historical scopes and complex multi-state disclosures.
* Supports margin and discount discipline by minimizing re-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.

**For the Team Raises talent density through:**

* Mentorship and coaching of juniors on VCS standards, nexus and exposure judgment, and client communication. Structured review and quality control discipline for voluntary compliance spreadsheets and historical returns.
* Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.
* For Our AI-First Strategy Improves turnaround time per voluntary disclosure / historical project.
* Increases accuracy and consistency across returns, disclosure spreadsheets, and periods. Raises analyst productivity and independence by leveraging AI-enabled workflows already defined for the team.

**Responsibilities (Outcome-Based Ownership)**

Own end-to-end preparation, processing, analysis, and quality assurance of historical Sales & Use tax data and returns for multi-period, multi-jurisdiction VCS engagements — including custom pSTRA, Tax Summary Reports, and voluntary compliance spreadsheets submitted to state taxing authorities — so returns are accurate and ready to be filed, delivering

* 99% accuracy and 98–100% on-time SLA adherence.
* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client transactional data, prior filings, and proposed disclosure returns, including altering or adding transaction data where required while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Serve as the senior primary point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, owning sensitive negotiations and status conversations.
* Maintain a 24-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to voluntary disclosures, historical returns, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of complex, historical transaction-level data and U.S. Sales & Use tax law, ensuring data is accurately validated, troubleshot, transformed, and reported — including nexus setup — so historical returns and disclosures are prepared and ready to be filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% using AI-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly VCS status, nexus, risk, and exposure reporting using AI-enabled formatting and summarization tools.
* Identify and implement at least one scalable AI-enabled workflow enhancement within the first 6 months, with clear measurement of productivity or quality impact.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**

* The Senior Analyst, VCS must demonstrate exceptional applied AI capability that produces measurable operational impact, not just experimentation.
* This includes: Embedding AI tools into transactional data cleansing and enrichment, reconciliation and variance explanation, nexus and historical exposure summaries, pSTRA preparation, and VCS escalation workflows.

Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.
* Continuously identifying automation opportunities aligned to efficiency, risk reduction, scalability, and consistent client experience.
* Casual or convenience-based AI usage does not meet Avalara’s AI Bar Raiser standard.

**12-Month Success Signals**

Within 12 months, the Senior Analyst, VCS will demonstrate: Sustained

* 99% preparation accuracy across their VCS portfolio (returns prepared for filing, disclosure spreadsheets, amendments, and corrections).
* 98–100% on-time performance for agreed VCS SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi-state disclosures.
* 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.

* At least one implemented AI-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, pSTRA/template builders, data-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.

* Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty and interest issues, nexus questions).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA, large data-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to prepare accurate disclosures and historical returns ready for filing.
* Proven experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex historical tax, nexus, and exposure topics in clear, client-friendly language to customers, project managers, and state taxing authorities.

title: Assistant Vice President - Legal Discovery Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

**Job Title**
-------------


eDiscovery Operations – Sr Counsel

**Description**
---------------


Legal Discovery Management (LDM) is an internal organization within the firm's Litigation Department.


As a Senior Counsel in Legal discovery operations team you will support and facilitate the legal discovery process, including the identification, preservation, collection, review, and production of information relevant to litigation matters, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations.


Duties will include but will not be limited to: performing custodial/data source research and identification, along with the preservation, collection, disposition, and/or secure delivery of data within pre\-defined Service Level Agreements; acting as liaison between LDM and its partners, participating in end\-to\-end eDiscovery projects and programs with a focus on process improvement; managing various projects with multiple stakeholders; coordinating project milestones and deliverables; working directly with all staff levels from analysts to senior management, and delivering results on both near\- and long\-term initiatives.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as a point\-of\-contact for legal teams, advising and coordinating discovery activities.
* Respond to and fulfill eDiscovery requests across various data sources, including but not limited to electronic communications, voice, structured and unstructured data sources.
* Coordinate the discovery lifecycle among all collaborating parties, including the firm's internal attorneys, outside counsel, vendors, and the firm's internal discovery IT group.
* Conduct early matter outreach, discovery planning, budgeting, custodian scoping, tracking, status reporting, managing to timelines and overseeing production requests.
* Coordinate with internal IT and business partners, and external vendors in support of request fulfillment, including restoration of data with appropriate chain\-of\-custody documentation, where required.
* Oversee day\-to\-day case details for certain matter types. Maintain a level of understanding of the business uses for the systems from which data is being requested and proactively address questions related to fulfilling such requests.
* Act as a liaison between the eDiscovery team and global systems and data center contacts, including but not limited to tape operations areas/data centers and third parties, to manage various legal discovery requests.
* Facilitate the flow of documents and knowledge throughout the discovery process: direct documents into the appropriate workstreams and transmit questions, answers, and information to/from the managed review vendor and internal or external counsel.
* Support the continuous improvement of eDiscovery operational processes globally, including request processing, research, preservation, collection, disposition, delivery, and control.
* Draft and/or review process management documentation, maintain organized updates and detailed matter/project notes and documentation.
* Data\-driven problem solving and decision making; manage and appropriately escalate delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes associated with process enhancement initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
-----------------------------------------------------




* Law Graduate / J.D. from an accredited law school.  

Attorney must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing in the state/jurisdiction in which the position is based or otherwise in compliance with the in\-house counsel registration rules of that state/jurisdiction.
* Minimum 5\+ years of discovery experience at a financial services provider, consulting firm, discovery vendor, or top\-tier law firm, with cross\-EDRM hands\-on and advisory experience.
* Understanding of firm change management processes and procedures (SDLC, etc.) and experience working in a secure environment with sensitive data, including PII.
* Familiarity with Electronically Stored Information ESI investigation procedures, preservation, disposition, recovery, and analysis of data from a variety of electronic communication, voice, and unstructured systems (e.g., M365 Purview, MS Exchange, Connected Archive, Lotus Notes, Robocopy, OnTrack, Hard Drives, Ascent, Digital Safe, NICE, Cisco, SharePoint), backup tape infrastructure (ArcServe, TSM, TDP, NetBackup), structured data systems, databases and/or EDRM (eDiscovery Reference Model), or litigation support\-related experience.
* Project Management, ITIL, ACEDS, PMP background.
* Familiarity with, knowledge of, or understanding of legal chain\-of\-custody requirements, regulatory processes, and basic Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
* Self\-motivated, highly flexible, organized, and team\-oriented, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and manage confidential and/or sensitive, time\-critical, and competing priorities and projects. Comfortable responding to shifting priorities and working independently with minimal supervision.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.
